---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, enhancement, or new feature for ANSImuz
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## Feature Category
Select the relevant area:
- [ ] Playback & Controls (playback engine, volume, repeat, shuffle)
- [ ] Queue & History System
- [ ] UI & Theming (Ratatui layout, colors, font styling)
- [ ] Terminal Artwork & Visuals
- [ ] Music Providers (YouTube Music, Spotify, new providers)
- [ ] Keybindings & Command Palette
- [ ] Settings & Configuration

## Problem Statement / Motivation
A clear description of the problem or limitation this feature addresses (e.g. *"I often want to..."* or *"Currently, it is difficult to..."*).

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you would like to happen:
- How should the user interact with this feature?
- What keyboard shortcut, menu item, or UI element would trigger it?
- How should it behave across different terminal dimensions (e.g. wide 3-panel vs compact mode)?

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative approaches, designs, or workarounds you have considered.

## Mockups / ASCII Concept / Additional Context
Add any ASCII terminal mockups, screenshots, or additional context to help visualize the feature idea.
